text.p: --Barrington Research Associates Inc said Tuesday it cut its earnings estimates for Unitog Co but has maintained its top buy rating on the stock.

For the fourth quarter, Barrington projected earnings of $0.39 a share versus $0.32 last year, down from the previous estimate of $0.44. The total for the year is pegged at $1.35 versus $1.23 last year, down from the previous estimate of $1.45.

--Analyst Alexander Paris said assimilation and integration costs following recent acquisitions are expected to continue into the fourth quarter, but the management fully expects record revenues and earnings in 1997.
--The stock traded at 27-1/8, off 3/8 from the previous close. The high for the year was $32.
